title: Detailed trumpet
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell of the trumpet -->
  <polygon points='70,30 96,18 96,58 70,46' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <polygon points='70,30 96,18 96,26 70,36' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <polygon points='70,46 96,58 96,50 70,40' fill='#E0A92E'/>
  <ellipse cx='96' cy='38' rx='3' ry='20' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <ellipse cx='96' cy='38' rx='1.5' ry='16' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <!-- Bell to body transition -->
  <polygon points='62,34 70,30 70,46 62,42' fill='#E8B93A'/>
  <!-- Main tube -->
  <rect x='28' y='33' width='36' height='10' rx='2' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <rect x='28' y='33' width='36' height='3' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <rect x='28' y='40' width='36' height='3' fill='#D99B22'/>
  <!-- Second tube (return loop) -->
  <rect x='34' y='44' width='26' height='8' rx='2' fill='#F2B92E'/>
  <rect x='34' y='44' width='26' height='2.5' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <!-- Round bend connecting tubes on right -->
  <path d='M60 33 Q66 43 60 52' fill='none' stroke='#FFD24A' stroke-width='6'/>
  <path d='M60 33 Q66 43 60 52' fill='none' stroke='#FFE99A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Round bend on left -->
  <path d='M34 52 Q28 43 34 33' fill='none' stroke='#F2B92E' stroke-width='6'/>
  <!-- Leadpipe going to mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='10' y='31' width='20' height='9' rx='2' fill='#FFE07A'/>
  <rect x='10' y='31' width='20' height='2.5' fill='#FFF3C4'/>
  <!-- Tuning slide U-bend under -->
  <path d='M16 40 Q16 50 26 50 L40 50' fill='none' stroke='#F2B92E' stroke-width='5'/>
  <path d='M16 40 Q16 50 26 50 L40 50' fill='none' stroke='#FFE99A' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- Mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='3' y='30' width='8' height='11' rx='2' fill='#E8B93A'/>
  <rect x='2' y='28' width='4' height='15' rx='2' fill='#FFF3C4'/>
  <!-- Valves casing -->
  <rect x='40' y='18' width='7' height='22' rx='2' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <rect x='49' y='18' width='7' height='22' rx='2' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <rect x='58' y='18' width='7' height='22' rx='2' fill='#FFD24A'/>
  <rect x='40' y='18' width='7' height='3' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <rect x='49' y='18' width='7' height='3' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <rect x='58' y='18' width='7' height='3' fill='#FFE99A'/>
  <!-- Valve caps/buttons -->
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='15' r='4' fill='#FFF3C4'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='15' r='4' fill='#FFF3C4'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='15' r='4' fill='#FFF3C4'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='13' r='1.6' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <circle cx='52.5' cy='13' r='1.6' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='13' r='1.6' fill='#C98A1E'/>
  <!-- Spit valve at bottom -->
  <rect x='64' y='47' width='4' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#E8B93A'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='55' r='2.5' fill='#FFF3C4'/>
</svg>
